name: augnes-operator
description: Augnes workflow harness plus a fail-closed macOS Companion service lifecycle and exact canonical repository continuity.

interface.shortDescription: Use Augnes workflow skills inside Codex.
interface.longDescription: Packages Augnes workflow skills, bounded status and start controls for an explicitly installed checkout-bound macOS Companion service, and exact canonical continuity through one verified live Companion without mock or fallback state.
interface.defaultPrompt: For fresh repository continuation, call augnes_companion_lifecycle_status for the exact current root; if startable, call augnes_start_companion_service once; after live verification, call augnes_resume_repository once.
